discussions.name: NWS Seattle
synopsis: A strong frontal system will bring gusty winds and additional rainfall to western Washington tonight and Friday. A warm front will boost temperatures as it moves northwards into the area Saturday. A follow-up cold front Saturday night into Sunday will bring another round of rain and gusty winds. The weather pattern remains active into at least the first half of next week.
hydrology: River flooding is not expected through the next seven days. However, a series of increasingly wet weather systems will bring rain (and high mountain snow) to the region, especially from Friday onward. While current forecasts are not expected to cause flooding, this will begin to saturate soils and raise base flows that could bring a concern with subsequent storms systems into next week.

discussions.name: NWS Portland
synopsis: Mostly dry weather today before wetter and more active weather returns Friday. Additional chances for rain return late Saturday afternoon into Sunday, and Monday through the middle of next week. South winds become breezy later Saturday afternoon and evening.
